main_text.p: donec consumeretur totum illud volu-men:Jerem.36.v.23. Et Antiochus Epi-phanes legis divinæ libros concerpi atq; igni concremari jussit,&apud quemcun-que liber federis deprehensus esset, aut si quis favisset legi, is edicto regis morte multabatur: 1. Macch.1. vers.59.60. Sic Photii, patriarchæ Constantinopolitani, librum, contra Romanæ ecclesiæ ambi-tionem scriptum, Hadrianus pontifex igni Romæ tradidit.In Vercellensi syno-do, sub Leone IX, libri Johannis Scoti de eucharistia damnati sunt. Subinco, co-gnomine Lepus, episcopus Pragensis, Johannis Wiclefi, Angli, volumina publicè cōcremari jussit. Et libros Johannis Hussi in Concilio Constantiensi, M. Lutheri verò à Leone x, Romæ publicè exustos esse, notius est, quàm quod prolixiori o-pus habeat indicatione. Quò magis libris orthodoxis, & ecclesiæ utilibus, Impp. re-gum, principum, magnatumque mundi hujus opus est præsidio, patrocinio & tu-telâ.
Has dedicationū causas exactiùs me-cum reputans, de cujus titulo atque no-mine libelli hujus frontem potius muni-rem, quàm de Tuæ Celsit. Illustrissime

page.notes: The first paragraph continues from the previous page. The text breaks off mid-sentence at the foot ("Illustrissime"), so the paragraph continues on the next page. "Celsit." is printed without its ending and is kept as printed. "ecclesiæ" in the second-last line of the first paragraph shows a ligature that may be æ; read as æ. Printed errors such as "tradidit.In" are left as printed. No page number, catchword or signature is visible.
